t2_generic_motivation: Consistency is the real key to success. As founders we must never give up, keep pushing even when it is hard, trust the process and believe in the journey. Every single day is a new opportunity to grow and become a better version of yourself.
t4_news_no_insight: Saw in the news this week that the Indian beauty and personal care market is growing really fast and a big conglomerate just launched another skincare brand. Lots of funding is going into D2C beauty right now. Interesting times for the industry, I should probably post something about it.
t5_unsupported_claim: Honestly I think ninety percent of Indian skincare brands fake their stability data and everyone in the industry knows it. Most serums on the market are basically useless and some are dangerous. I want to write a post calling this out because people deserve to know.
t6_confidential: Our supplier Aroma Chem in Vapi quoted us 1,450 rupees per kilo for the new ceramide blend and we are renegotiating the contract next week before the Diwali launch. Also a customer, Priya Sharma, priya.sharma84@gmail.com, who has eczema, wrote that our cream burned her face. I want to write about supplier pricing and customer complaints.
